text: ktech (Kuwait Technical College) is a private institution of higher education based in Kuwait, specialised in technical and applied training; its governing Board of Trustees has five members and is chaired by Meshari Ayman Boodai.

source.name: CA Osasuna: 'Osasuna y Ktech establecen una nueva alianza para las próximas tres temporadas'
source.quote: ktech es una institución privada de educación superior con sede en Kuwait especializada en formación técnica y aplicada
source.note: The club article also names 'Meshari Boodai, presidente del Consejo de Administración de Kuwait Technical College'. ktech's own site (ktech.edu.kw/en/about-us/about-board-of-trustees-/) lists the five trustees: 'MR. MESHARI AYMAN BOODAI – Chairman'.
